{{Quote|But I only had the one! And the Arkanian engineer who crafted it is long dead.|[[Peema Ahuff]], on the hyperdrive|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] '''engineer''' designed a [[Arkanian hyperdrive|hyperdrive]] that was eventually acquired by [[House Alde]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] was long [[Death/Legends|dead]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />
